reason: No common method-legal action set could be defined across all three frameworks without changing a method's decision space.
detail: CC uses a CoverageAction from the current mask; D->P requires a frozen RegionTask and precomputed gate pair; P->D requires its contextual region/repair and gate key. A CC action on a D/P pre-resupply state is not a legal D/P decoder action.
conclusion: No counterfactual early-resupply claim is made.
